_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Update when Anthropic prices change. FEAT-025: keys are matched EXACTLY (or exact-key + '-YYYYMMDD' date suffix) against the model field on assistant messages via priceFor() in session-cost.mts -- no more bare-prefix matching (that silently priced e.g. claude-opus-4-9 at claude-opus-4 rates).

_keys.cache_create_5m: Tokens written to the ephemeral 5-minute prompt cache. Formula when not independently priced: 1.25x input.
_keys.cache_create_1h: Tokens written to the ephemeral 1-hour prompt cache. Formula when not independently priced: 2x input.
_keys.cache_read: Tokens served from the prompt cache.
_keys.source: Optional per-model provenance: "audit" = taken directly from docs/audits/2026-11-05/audit-synthesis.md §3.7; "assumed" = no exact-name quote in that audit for this model id, same-family (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) rate reused. Absent = legacy table entry predating this field.
